notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
Bright-Palm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Bright-Palm as an attacker.
Bright-Palm triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
